## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant browser workflows were checked, or the verification limit is stated.
- [ ] Sources, units, photo credits and limitations are preserved where relevant.
- [ ] A calculation change updates the model version and saved-plan compatibility policy.

## Evidence and limits

For scientific changes, cite sources and regional scope. Separate software checks from agricultural validation. Note known risks, unavailable data or remaining work.
